verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Semgrep publishes a working llms.txt at docs.semgrep.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) listing structured doc links, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at an llms.txt-style resource. Missing for 10: broader agent-oriented documentation beyond the llms.txt file itself, and independent (non-probe) corroboration of its usefulness to agents.
